en.hubeali: H 14684 – Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfaly, from Al-Sakuny, who has narrated:
Abu Abdullahasws says that the Rasool Allahsaww said: ‘The expiration of the omen is the reliance (upon Allahazwj)’.
en.sarwar: 236. Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al-Nawfaly, from Al-Sakuny, who has narrated: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) says that the Rasool Allah (saww) said: ‘The expiration of the omen is the reliance (upon Allah (azwj))’.
